description: Show your solidarity and support for all military personnel serving with our Womens R.E.D. (Remember Everyone Deployed) T-Shirt. This patriotic shirt features a graphic design on the front that honors deployed service members, along with a distressed American Flag on the right sleeve. Unbelievable Comfort: Made from a special Cotton/Polyester blend, the women’s R.E.D. shirt is silky-smooth and soft to the touch. For added comfort, these graphic tees feature flat seams at the collar, sleeves, and bottom hem, as well as a tag-less label. Comfortable and Easygoing: Designed with a flattering fit and curved hem, this crewneck t-shirt sits just right while complementing your body. These comfy t-shirts feature a raglan sleeve style as well. Land of the Free: Whether you’re out hiking on a trail, spending a day at the beach, or casually walking around town, our Remember Everyone Deployed T-Shirts are great for weekend adventures, working-out, everyday use, and more. They’re also perfect for showcasing your American spirit during 4th of July, Memorial Day, and Veterans Day. Complete the Look: Our R.E.D. (Remember Everyone Deployed) T-Shirt goes especially well with a pair of our Womens Vintage Paratrooper Fatigue Pants or BDU Cargo Pants.
